claims.claim_text: Equinix operates 280 data centers across 77 markets in 36 countries, including 23 xScale data centers and the MC1 and SN1 IBX data centers held in unconsolidated joint ventures.
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.object_value: 280 data centers / 77 markets / 36 countries; 23 xScale + 2 IBX in JVs (unconsolidated)
claims.source_quote: Our extensive global footprint spans 280 data centers, in 77 markets in 36 countries. ... including 23 xScale data centers and the MC1 and SN1 data centers that are held in unconsolidated joint ventures.

claims.claim_text: Equinix recognized $9.217 billion of total revenue in FY2025 with no single customer accounting for 10% or greater of revenue or A/R; ~$8.7B is recurring (colocation + interconnection + managed infrastructure).
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.source_quote: Total revenues (2) 4,111 3,130 1,976 9,217 ... no single customer accounted for 10% or greater of our accounts receivable or revenues as at or for the year ended December 31, 2025.

claims.subject: Equinix
claims.object_value: xScale JVs targeting hyperscale cloud customers; 23 unconsolidated xScale DCs
claims.source_quote: xScale Data Centers are designed to serve the unique core workload deployment needs of a targeted group of hyperscale companies, which include the world's largest cloud service providers ... developed and operated through our joint venture partnership arrangements

claims.claim_text: Equinix had Annualized Gross Bookings of $1.6 billion in 2025, up 27% YoY, with the metric described as MRR-based on contracts that begin within 90 days (i.e. near-term operational bookings, not headline TCV).
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.object_value: $1.6B AGB in 2025; +27% YoY; only contracts that start within 90 days
claims.source_quote: During the year ended December 31, 2025, we had total Annualized Gross Bookings of $1.6 billion, up 27% from 2024 ... This measure only includes contracts that we anticipate will start generating revenue within 90 days.

claims.claim_text: Equinix has 52 active major development projects underway across 35 metros expected to deliver 55,000+ retail cabinets and 100+ MW of xScale capacity through 2028, with $6.5B of total capex tied to specific named under-construction projects.
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.object_value: 52 projects / 35 metros / 55K+ cabinets retail + 100+ MW xScale / $6.549B total capex / target opens Q1 2026 – Q4 2028
claims.source_quote: We had 52 active major development projects underway as of January 2026 across 35 metros around the world. We anticipate these development projects will deliver 55,000+ cabinets of retail capacity and 100+ MW of xScale capacity through 2028.

claims.claim_text: Equinix has approximately $18.4B in senior notes principal outstanding and $6.3B of unaccrued capex contractual commitments; FY2025 operating cash flow $3.911B vs investing outflow $6.484B (heavy capex / land buildout).
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.object_value: $18.4B senior notes / $6.3B capex commitments / OCF $3.911B / investing -$6.484B / $3.2B cash + $4.0B revolver + $1.2B ATM unused
claims.source_quote: approximately $18.4 billion of principal from our senior notes ... approximately $6.3 billion of unaccrued capital expenditure contractual commitments ... Net cash provided by operating activities $ 3,911 ... Net cash used in investing activities (6,484)

claims.claim_text: Equinix received SEC and US Attorney (NDCA) subpoenas in 2024 regarding accounting practices; the SEC closed its investigation on November 19, 2025 with no enforcement action recommended, and the related stockholder class action was settled (covered by insurance) and dismissed with prejudice December 19, 2025.
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.predicate: resolved SEC/NDCA investigation + securities class action
claims.object_value: SEC closed Nov 19 2025 no action; class action settled & dismissed Dec 19 2025 covered by insurance; derivative suits dismissed Apr/Aug 2025; one Delaware derivative suit still pending (MTD filed Oct 20 2025)
claims.source_quote: On November 19, 2025, the Company received correspondence from the SEC indicating that the agency had concluded its investigation and does not intend to recommend an enforcement action ... The case was dismissed with prejudice on December 19, 2025, and the settlement was covered entirely by our insurance.

claims.claim_text: Equinix is winding down its Equinix Metal product (announced Q4 2024; final completion expected Q4 2026), and took a Q4 2024 impairment of $131M PP&E + $29M intangibles plus a Hong Kong IBX impairment of $73M; FY2025 impairment charges were $68M.
claims.subject: Equinix
claims.predicate: discloses product wind-down and asset impairments
claims.object_value: Equinix Metal wind-down by Q4 2026; Q4'24 impairments: $131M PP&E + $29M intangibles (Metal) and $38M ROU + $35M PP&E (Hong Kong IBX); 2025 impairment charges $68M
claims.source_quote: In the fourth quarter of 2024, we announced the decision to make Equinix Metal no longer commercially available as a product and to wind down operations that support this product by June 2026 ... We recorded impairment charges of $ 131 million and $ 29 million ...
